text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while strolling through town
and doing
a bit of shopping...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Have you seen Taishin?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's strange. I'm sure she came
this way!
choice_data_list: I don't think I saw it, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's going on, but Twin
Turbo is
searching rather frantically. I
watch as she zooms
around a corner and
disappears from sight.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, this feels a little mean! She's
trying so
desperately to find you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't care.
Hey, sorry, but pretend you
didn't see me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Narita Taishin is avoiding
Twin Turbo.
Curious, I ask why.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know how Taishin is super good at
mobile
games? Well...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch, you little...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right, level cleared.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're so good!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And so she thinks Taishin is like this
total gaming
pro! That's why she's been
chasing her
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
See, I had the same thought. But
Taishin...
choice_data_list: Wouldn't one race get it out of your system?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't wanna. She grates on me. Plus, I
get the
vibe she won't quit until she
finally wins.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Oh crap.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I'm sure I heard her voice! I definitely, definitely heard it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Those footsteps sound exactly like Taishin's!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Taishiiin! Play a game with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch! You really don't give up, do you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Play with me, play with me! I won't stop
following
you until you say yes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Urk...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sick of running around... But one
game is all
you're getting.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Raaah! Foo! Ahahaha! Turbo Booost!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're not half bad. But can you handle
this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two become fully absorbed in the
game while
they duke it out. It seems
they've forgotten all
about the hassles
that led them here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Graaah! She got away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haha, Taishin is as agile as ever!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh! I just wanted to play with heeer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about this? I'll play with you
instead!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a gaming pro like Taishin, but I'm
decent
at hoops and air hockey!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, air hockey's super fun! Again!
Let's play
again!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! I won't lose this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a spirited air hockey session, the
two make
plans to visit an arcade with
sports games.
